places.name: Hive Board Game Cafe
places.description: Board-game café with 500+ games, shelves of books and comfort food, plus regular game nights and workshops. Open late; staff help you pick and learn a game.

places.name: Kefi Books, Board Games & Coffee
places.description: A library café in Al Mamzar with 200+ board games, thousands of books, speciality coffee and a co-working corner. Hosts game nights; students and children get special rates.

places.name: Pots & Paints Cafe
places.description: Paint-your-own-pottery café: choose a mug, vase or trinket box, decorate it over a coffee and collect it after firing. Good for kids, dates and small groups.

places.name: The Workshop
places.description: Café in a two-storey Jumeirah villa with board games to borrow and an escape-room experience, plus a relaxed all-day menu.

places.name: Moon Lake (Crescent Lake)
places.description: A crescent-shaped man-made lake deep in the Al Qudra dunes, near Love Lake, with oryx and gazelles around. There is no paved road – you need a 4x4 to reach it. Best at sunrise or sunset; bring water and avoid summer midday heat.
